searchText: Will EIP-2327 be obsolete / fully covered if the EIP-615-style work (EIP-2315, EIP-3540, EIP-3670, EIP-3690, EIP-4200, etc) goes through? Specifically is EIP-4573 a generalised version or effective superset of EIP-2327? EIP-2327: https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-2327 EIP-4573: https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-4573 EIP-2327 -- BEGINDATA, will be superseded by the Ethereum Object Format. https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-3540
